exposure: gestational age at delivery (400/7-406/7 weeks, 410/7-416/7 weeks, 420/7-426/7 weeks)
outcome: need for neonatal intensive care unit admission
cohort: 476 patients who gave birth between October 2016 and October 2017 at the Obstetrics and Gynecology Clinic of Prof. Dr. Cemil Tascioglu City Hospital, University of Health Sciences Turkey.
finding: There was no significant difference in adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes between 400/7 and 426/7 gestational weeks.
